description: Four body-supported public-action candidates remain pending because no source reports the number present simultaneously: Nov 5 Machinga TTC march, Nov 6 Dedza TTC protest, Nov 13 Lilongwe electoral-reform protest and Nov 25 Lilongwe fuel/electoral protest. E005 is still only a search-result lead.
required_followup: Find contemporary sources giving attendance at each gathering; for E005, first obtain a permitted source confirming occurrence, date and state demand. Do not use college enrollment or forecasts as turnout.

description: MW24N014's requested Malawi Freedom Network article redirected to an unrelated 2026 biography; its body was not obtained. MW24N017 is a separate Times Group report available only as a search result, and another Times URL in December returned an anti-bot challenge. E005 remains pending evidence.
required_followup: Use a permitted alternative outlet or official record for the Ndirande incident. Do not retry MW24N014 or assume the Times challenge's scope extends beyond its observed URL.

description: The Nov 21 CDEDI plan was reported postponed/rescheduled to Nov 25, which is coded separately. Nov 25 organizer stated an intention to continue, but no later action/date was established. The Nov 5/6/Dec-reported TTC allowance actions may share a policy issue, but coordination/onset is unknown.
required_followup: Check post-event sources and adjacent months for actual continuation, and determine whether separate TTC actions were coordinated; preserve distinct local episodes unless evidence resolves linkage.

description: A Dec 3 article (units/malawi/2024-12, MW24D001) reports 635 Lilongwe TTC student teachers had boycotted classes for about three weeks, suggesting an approximate mid-November start. It describes no march or other public event and gives no exact onset date; enrollment/participation figures are not protest turnout.
required_followup: Search for contemporaneous reports of a public student gathering during November and clarify onset/coordination with Dedza and Machinga actions; do not code a class boycott alone as a public protest.

description: English month-wide and week-windowed searches, Chichewa terms, official MANA/MBC queries and follow-ups identified events in Lilongwe, Machinga and Dedza. No comprehensive local reporting sweep was completed for Mzuzu, Zomba, Mangochi and other districts; usable Chichewa results were limited. CIVICUS is retrospective and its linked story/provenance relationship to contemporary sources was not fully resolved.
required_followup: Search remaining feasible regions/sectors and obtain linked contemporary source coverage where permitted; record any shared origin or republication before treating sources as independent.

description: Open-web search is not LexisNexis and does not support exhaustiveness. Candidate thresholds remain unresolved; zero verified provisional candidates is not zero protests.
required_followup: Continue permitted source/diversity and adjacent-month follow-ups; keep official baseline pending.
